title: CMA Fest Crash Pad! 25 minutes by car to downtown
description:
My town of Mount Juliet is just outside of Nashville. 18 minutes to the airport and 25 minutes from downtown. You'll have access to 2 bedrooms and 1.5 baths in my townhouse in a very quiet and serene setting to sleep off your hangovers.  Walkable, yet quiet community as it's on the edge of a stream, a farm, and other large undeveloped tracts of land.

The space
Luxury townhouse unit in a walkable community and 15 just a minute drive to two of middle Tennessee's best lakes. Beautiful walking trail. There is NO TELEVISION in the home, but I have high speed internet for streaming YouTube, Hulu, etc.

Guest access
This property provides secure, keyless entry with a personalized deadbolt code. The master bedroom and some closets will be locked, but the rest of the unit and the common areas are yours to enjoy.

During your stay
I'll be at home during your stay, and will be reachable by text and phone.
